the sole statement of `parse`'s `rescue JSON::ParseException` body; an empty rescue body evaluates to nil, so commenting it out leaves `parse` returning nil on a parse failure exactly as the explicit `nil` does.

`Hash#values` returns a freshly-allocated Array on every call, so sorting it in place mutates nothing `@injected` holds; `sort_by` (allocate-and-return) and `sort_by!` (sort-in-place-and-return) leave `entries` holding the identical sorted contents. `sort_by!` is kept because ameba's Performance/ChainedCallWithNoBang requires it after `values`.
